workflow.heading: An assistant that organizes your sessions and supports your clients
workflow.subheading: Give your clients a simple, instant experience: booking becomes fast, frictionless, and effortless.

steps.title: Set up your workspace
steps.description: Create your account, set your weekly availability, and add the services you offer. In just a few minutes, everything is ready.

steps.title: Bring your clients in
steps.description: Clients book directly on your private calendar. Travel times are automatically included, without ever revealing your address.

steps.title: Finally take time for yourself
steps.description: Your schedule builds and reshuffles automatically. Less back-and-forth, less stress, and more time to breathe… or enjoy your day.

steps.title: Run your day
steps.description: Each day, access your optimized route in one click. Open Google Maps instantly to get to your next appointment.

steps.title: Watch your revenue grow
steps.description: By optimizing your schedule and cutting unnecessary driving, you free up more bookable time, more sessions, less fatigue.

bottom.pitchLine2: More spontaneous bookings, instant client trust…
bottom.pitchLine3: Let us prove it to you.
